design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST (revision 5). Lavonne Dukes added her 16-year-old nephew Jaylen (other_relative, 3 points) to her Georgia owner term CPA-GA-1384402 on 2026-11-23 (additional premium 224.31 = 350.00 x 116 / 181). An SR-22 Owner-Operator certificate was requested on 2026-11-25 and filed on 2026-11-26; its filing fee of 25.00 was assessed 2026-11-25 and is billed on the next invoice under the filing charter, and the term's financial_responsibility_filing names sr22. She paid 120.00 online on 2026-11-30. That payment found nothing past due and no current invoice, so it is held whole as a credit under the autopay owner-plan payment-application overwrite. She asks to pay toward her nephew's added premium by debit card. The deposit rule's prerequisite sentence ("The endorsement deposit is fixed only after every installment whose invoice date has arrived is invoiced on the plan.") makes the agent see that installment 3 is not invoiced (due 2026-12-19, invoice date 2026-12-09 = frozen date). The draft notice (5 factors) is issued first. The deposit (6 factors) is then figured on the endorsement balance, net of the credit still held, and handed to her.

SCOPE. Task 0 owns billing_ext_draft_notice (issue_draft_notice_1682239d; draft notices on Monthly EFT or Monthly Card Autopay owner plans only) and billing_ext_endorsement_deposit (authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd, user; Monthly EFT or Card Autopay owner plans only, the plans whose waited-on invoice the draft notice issues). Task 1 owns the returned-payment makeup, the switch down payment and the move to direct bill. The first invoice after such a move follows the move's own schedule; later invoices of a moved plan follow the base installment rule, never the draft notice.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Draw: 1 prerequisite, factor_counts [6, 5] (deposit 6, notice 5).
- Edge deposit -> notice: value_input, gate dep_endorsement_billed, state form, connective "only after".
- It waits on an installment invoice row for every installment whose invoice date has arrived. On an owner-term plan every installment is invoiced on its invoice date even when a credit covers it (declared scoped overwrite of the base credit sentence), so the sentence has one reading and cannot deadlock.
- False at the opening: only installments 1-2 are invoiced.
- Deletion sensitivity: deposit 66.06 without the notice, 43.97 with it.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
- Notice: billing_installment_schedule.one_invoice_per_installment.
- Declared overwrites on the notice:
  - S3 (what the notice bills);
  - S5 (on Monthly EFT and Card Autopay owner plans, credits are carried by the notice's credit schedule, or by the first invoice after a move off automatic draft, and installments are invoiced even when covered; the base sentence is restated for every other plan);
  - the installment-fee sentence (the plan's installment_fee, unadjusted, plus the certificate fee recorded on the filing ledger);
  - the payment-application sentence: on Monthly EFT and Card Autopay owner plans (base restated for every other plan), what a payment leaves after past-due invoices, fees and the current invoice is held as a credit; endorsement deposits and switch down payments are held as their own schedules state. The deposit obeys this one overwrite too.
- Deposit: single_payment_cap, certified_method. The authorization sentence is retired for the deposit only, by sibling overwrites that name the makeup and the switch down payment.

FACTOR CARD - notice (327.36; all-baseline 158.01; per-factor baselines endorsement_spread 252.59, credit_spread 247.36, filer_endorsement_advance 321.75, points_endorsement_advance 321.75, package_endorsement_advance 324.00).
- endorsement_spread: 224.31 not yet billed, 3 unbilled -> 74.77.
- credit_spread: credit 120.00 >= 100 with 3 unbilled -> carry 40.00 of it; baseline carries all 120.00.
- Endorsement premium billed ahead, under the company's filed percentages of the 224.31 not yet billed: SR-22 the term backs 2.5%, 8 violation points 2.5%, 50/100/50 package 1.5%, together 14.58.
- Fee: the Card Autopay plan's installment_fee 6.00 plus the recorded certificate fee 25.00 (assessed 2026-11-25, after the 2026-11-09 invoice, not reversed). Both are plain, not factors.
- Near-miss: the 120.00 payment is a plain payment, not a deposit.

FACTOR CARD - deposit (43.97; all-baseline 25.00; per-factor baselines deposit_by_installments_left 41.49, added_driver_age_addition 38.47, added_driver_points_addition 41.22, endorsement_size_addition 41.22, coverage_window_addition 41.22, household_relationship_addition 41.22).
- Balance 224.31 - 89.35 billed on notice 3 - 80.00 credit still held beyond it = 54.96.
- Core: one share of two.
- Additions of 30%: age, points, size, window, relationship.

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers -> verify -> find_billing_plans -> find_auto_policies -> find_auto_policy_changes -> find_auto_premium_transactions -> find_fr_filings -> find_fr_filing_transactions -> find_billing_invoices -> find_billing_transactions -> find_billing_authorizations -> unlock+call issue_draft_notice_1682239d(plan, 3, 2026-12-19, 336.36, 31.00, -40.00, 327.36) -> unlock+call(user) authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd(plan, additional premium txn, debit_card, 43.97). Verified with a scratch evaluator over the check_compute primitives.

PERSONA. Calm caregiver. She volunteers the goal, her name and phone; gives DOB, then ZIP or license last four only when asked; lets the agent do what must be done first; pays the stated amount by debit card; closes on the confirmation number. She names no bill, notice, credit, filing or amount.
user_scenario: You are Lavonne Dukes, a 39-year-old home health aide in Atlanta, calling Cardinal Point on your lunch break about the payment plan on your car insurance. Late last month you added your nephew Jaylen, who is sixteen and lives with you now, as a driver on your policy, and you would like to pay something toward his added premium today with your debit card, so it does not all end up on the credit card that your monthly drafts come out of. You have no idea what that amount should be; you expect the representative to work it out and tell you, and you will authorize the payment yourself. At the start you give your name, Lavonne Dukes, and the phone number on your account, 4045551273. If they need more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth, 1987-09-03; only if they still need something else do you give your ZIP code, 30310, or the last four of your driver's license, 1296. You do not know your policy or account numbers by heart and say so if asked. If the representative explains that something else on the account has to be taken care of first, you tell them to go ahead and do it; you do not ask about it further. When they hand you the payment to authorize, you pay with your debit card for exactly the amount they give you. If they ask whether you want anything else changed on the plan, you say no, just this payment. Once they tell you the payment went through and read you a confirmation number, you thank them and hang up.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_plan_id: Value 882e2fcb-0233-4496-be62-d95ab3481c30. Basis: find_billing_plans returns the customer's only plan. Uniqueness: single plan.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.installment_number: Value 3. Basis: notice rule "The notice's installment is the one after the installment invoices already issued on the plan". Uniqueness: invoices exist for installments 1 and 2 only.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.due_date: Value 2026-12-19. Basis: base billing_installment_schedule "each later installment installment_interval_months after the previous one, always on installment_due_day" (due day 19). Uniqueness: one date follows.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.premium_amount: Value 336.36: scheduled premium 247.01 + endorsement share 74.77 (224.31 / 3 installments unbilled) + 14.58 billed ahead (6.5% of 224.31: SR-22 2.5, 8 points 2.5, 50/100/50 1.5).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: Value 31.00: the Card Autopay plan's installment_fee 6.00 + the certificate filing fee 25.00 recorded on the filing ledger (assessed 2026-11-25, after the latest invoice 2026-11-09, not reversed).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.past_due_amount: Value -40.00: the plan holds a 120.00 credit (at least spread_min_credit) and three installments are unbilled, so the notice carries one equal share, 120.00 / 3.

edges.condition: for every installment whose invoice date (its due date less invoice_lead_days) is on or before the handling date, an installment invoice stands on the plan
edges.policy_source: The endorsement deposit is fixed only after every installment whose invoice date has arrived is invoiced on the plan.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Installment 3 is due 2026-12-19 and invoice_lead_days is 10, so its invoice date is 2026-12-09, the frozen date; the plan holds invoices only for installments 1 and 2.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The notice call creates the installment 3 invoice (premium 336.36), so dep_endorsement_billed becomes 89.35.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge (deposit after notice); reversing the writes gives a deposit of 66.06 on a world where installment 3 is still unbilled, which the prerequisite sentence excludes.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the notice write, dep_endorsement_billed stays 0.00 and three installments are unbilled: the deposit becomes 66.06 instead of 43.97, and no installment 3 invoice exists.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario names no notice, bill, invoice, fee or amount; the only conditional about other work is 'If the representative explains that something else on the account has to be taken care of first, you tell them to go ahead', a passive reply to the agent.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: authorize_endorsement_deposit_3483f9bd and issue_draft_notice_1682239d create their rows and update the plan balance unconditionally (task_tools.py bodies call ctx.create/ctx.update with the given arguments and read only the plan's own balance); neither checks invoices, dates or prerequisites.
